results.label: fixture has actual page input, JS state, cookies and local storage
browser replacement is an isolated SDK-only view of the existing native pane
selecting Browser Lab retains the native target and unsaved page state
the public snapshot and presentation identify the actual shell host
native page bounds match the plugin’s measured page slot and focus gutter
a plugin popup parks the native page before interaction
typed SDK capture reads the hosted page behind the parked popup
closing the plugin popup restores the same native page
bundled renderer restoration retains the live page and cookies
plugin reload restores its surface without recreating WebContents
client window reload preserves renderer selection and native page identity
a failed plugin releases geometry and falls back to the bundled browser
disabling the plugin returns to native controls with the page intact
reenabling restores the saved replacement and the same page
zooming a sibling parks the hidden browser without replacing its page
leaving sibling zoom restores the browser surface and live page
switching workspaces parks the plugin’s native browser page
returning to the workspace restores the same browser target and state
Cmd+L from the native page focuses the plugin address field
live navigation updates preserve an actively edited address draft
a typed address navigates the owning native tab and returns native focus
replacement Back follows native history
replacement Forward follows native history
Cmd+F from the native page opens the custom find row
custom Find reports native match results
custom Find can advance to the second native match
custom New tab creates a native tab and focuses the address
switching native tabs retains the original tab’s in-memory state
closing a custom tab removes only that native tab
custom bookmarks update daemon-owned favourites
bookmark popover participates in native occlusion
plugin zoom uses native page scaling
reset zoom restores native page geometry
resizing the client updates the exact reserved native page rectangle
an app settings modal covers and parks the replacement’s native page
closing the app modal restores the existing native page
a native element pick invalidates the public watch without polling inspector results
SDK inspector collects an actual native-page selection
clearing collected picks updates the public inspection metadata
a native batch pick invalidates the public browser watch
same-count batch comment edits advance the watch revision
private mode warns before discarding live page state
cancelling private mode leaves native page state untouched
private mode rebuilds against an isolated native session and clears stale inspection
plugin reload preserves the private page and its ephemeral session
leaving private mode restores the saved native session
a single native page crash recovers beneath the plugin controls
repeat native crashes show the host-owned recovery card
host recovery reload works with custom browser controls selected
embedded remote controls report that page display belongs to another shell
remote navigation targets its own native page and preserves the local address caret
the remote SDK refuses a pane from the local daemon
remote bundled browser preserves native address editing chords
remote bundled browser shortcuts search only their owning native page
phone Browser Lab controls remain available with an explicit native-display limit
phone browser controls fit the viewport and do not mount a terminal key bar
a direct browser client exposes controls without pretending to host native pixels
host loss updates availability and clears stale native inspection
returning to the original shell restores its same local page

The onscreen harness captures the composed native window, including its sibling WebContentsView. A separate native-page capture and placement logs corroborate page composition and ownership. Hidden screenshots are not visual evidence. Phone coverage uses emulation; physical-device keyboards and OS IME remain manual.
